The numbers run left to right, top to bottom over the top view. The model is
[`3d/mouse-joystick-pcb.glb`](3d/mouse-joystick-pcb.glb) (metres, Y up, the board's x and y along X and Z); the drawing
[`3d/top.svg`](3d/top.svg) is [`3d/top.png`](3d/top.png) at
12.38 px/mm with one rectangle per block, the union of its footprints' courtyards; both and the
footprints of each block are recorded in [`3d/hotspots.json`](3d/hotspots.json).
Each block's page shows the render clipped around its rectangle.
